scope: Columnwise Hadamard conjugation changes the phase on the all-ones control and target sector into a phase-free XOR of the target. Updating the target leaves its disjoint control predicate unchanged.

An exact, clean- and dirty-ancilla-free k-controlled NOT on the given physical register costs at most 1442k+4323 arbitrary one-/two-qubit gates. The word uses a Hadamard on the target on each side of the already compiled phase of angle π. Equality of full matrices eliminates residual global and relative phases.
